title: Klear Digital
concept: Digital marketing agency specializing in innovative solutions for business growth, building data-driven digital experiences for start-ups that are looking to resonate, scale and drive impact online.
description: Modern marketing agency website built with React and Tailwind CSS. Deployed on Vercel with serverless functions handling backend logic and Resend for email. Custom domain managed through GoDaddy.

features.fea_description: Fully responsive across all devices using Tailwind CSS for an adaptive, visually appealing layout.
Working contact form with real-time email delivery via Vercel Serverless Functions and Resend.
Clean, modern interface designed to capture leads and build trust with potential clients.

system_design_description: Lightweight serverless architecture using Vercel Functions for backend operations, Resend for email delivery, and GoDaddy for domain management. This setup keeps costs low while maintaining reliability and scalability.

system_design.system_description: Vercel Functions handle form submissions without a traditional server, keeping architecture simple and cost-effective.
Resend API integrated for secure email delivery without exposing API keys on the frontend.
GoDaddy domain connected to Vercel through DNS configuration for seamless deployment.
Client-side validation with error states ensures reliable form submission and delivery.

info.title: 🚧 Challenges
info.content: Frontend-only site needed a working contact form without a backend. Had to integrate email delivery across GoDaddy hosting and Vercel deployment seamlessly.

info.title: 🛠️ Solution
info.content: Implemented Vercel Serverless Functions as lightweight backend. Integrated Resend for secure email delivery. Connected GoDaddy domain via DNS with proper validation and error handling.

info.title: 🎉 Results
info.content: Fully functional contact form with real-time email delivery. Low maintenance costs with no traditional backend. Professional experience that captures more leads.

info.title: 🚀 Future Improvements
info.content: Add case studies showcasing agency work. Implement blog for marketing insights. Integrate chatbot for instant engagement. Optimize SEO for better visibility.

title: Evererdant
concept: Mobile-first platform connecting plant lovers to buy, sell, trade and share care tips. Seamlessly adopt and care for new plants using AI-powered recommendations and plantmates.
description: Mobile-first community platform for plant enthusiasts. Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, delivering a fast, responsive experience for buying, selling, and sharing plant care knowledge.

features.fea_description: Short quiz to give the best plant recommendations based on user preferences with the chatbot powered by Gemini AI and Anthropic API.
Share tips, ask questions, and connect with fellow plant enthusiasts.
Designed mobile-first with fast loading and smooth interactions on all devices.

system_design_description: Mobile-first architecture using React and TypeScript for type-safe development. AWS Amplify provides CDN and hosting, while Tailwind CSS keeps styling lean and performant.

system_design.system_description: React with TypeScript ensures type safety and maintainable code as the app scales.
Implemented lazy loading for images and integrated Cloudinary for fast global asset delivery.
Tailwind utility classes enable mobile-first design with minimal CSS overhead.
AWS Amplify handles image uploads and serves optimized assets through CDN.

info.title: 🚧 Challenges
info.content: Image-heavy plant listings caused slow load times on mobile networks, hurting user experience and Core Web Vitals.

info.title: 🛠️ Solution
info.content: Implemented lazy loading for off-screen images. Integrated AWS Amplify CDN for faster global delivery. Used Tailwind for lean, efficient styling.

info.title: 🎉 Results
info.content: 60% faster page loads on mobile. Lower bounce rates and higher engagement. Better SEO rankings from improved performance.

info.title: 🚀 Future Improvements
info.content: Build custom backend APIs. Add database for user profiles and listings. Enable real-time interactions and notifications.

title: Zodiac Wander
concept: Discover your zodiac sign, birth flower, personality traits, and share thoughts with the community.
description: Interactive platform blending astrology and nature. Explore zodiac signs, birth flowers, and personality traits while connecting with a cosmic community. Built with React, Express, and custom REST API.

features.fea_description: Discover detailed zodiac traits, compatibility, and daily horoscopes.
Connect your zodiac with unique birth flowers and their meanings.
Share reflections and connect with others on your cosmic journey.

system_design_description: Full-stack architecture with React frontend and Express backend. Structured JSON manages complex zodiac data including traits, compatibility, and user comments via REST API.

system_design.system_description: Nested JSON structure organizes zodiac content logically for easy access and maintenance.
Express backend serves zodiac data, horoscopes, and manages user comments.
React components consume structured data for consistent rendering across features.
JSON design allows easy migration to database system for future growth.

info.title: 🚧 Challenges
info.content: Complex zodiac data (traits, horoscopes, compatibility, comments) needed organized structure. Complicated JSON posed readability and scalability issues.

info.title: 🛠️ Solution
info.content: Designed nested JSON tree for logical, accessible data structure. Improved maintainability and set foundation for database migration.

info.title: 🎉 Results
info.content: Clean structure simplified data management and component consistency. Easy path for future backend integration and scaling.

info.title: 🚀 Future Improvements
info.content: Migrate to PostgreSQL backend. Improve mobile responsiveness. Add AI chatbot for horoscope interactions. Enable user photo uploads.

title: Tralli
concept: Mobile-first platform that connects homeowners and property managers with skilled trade professionals for repairs and maintenance.
description: Platform connecting property owners with trade professionals for building maintenance, repairs, and improvements. Built with React, Express, Firebase Auth, and MySQL for secure, scalable service matching.

features.fea_description: Find trusted trade professionals for maintenance, repairs, and improvements.
Google Sign-In via Firebase with additional data stored in MySQL.
Manage service requests, view provider details, and track job status.

system_design_description: Full-stack platform with React frontend and Express backend. Firebase handles authentication while MySQL stores user profiles and service listings. RESTful APIs ensure smooth data flow between components.

system_design.system_description: Firebase Auth for Google Sign-In with MySQL storing extended user profiles.
Express server handles business logic and serves data via REST endpoints.
MySQL stores users, service listings, and relationships for scalable growth.
React components consume API data for responsive, intuitive interface.

info.title: 🚧 Challenges
info.content: Integrating secure SSO required combining Firebase Authentication with MySQL while maintaining seamless user experience.

info.title: 🛠️ Solution
info.content: Implemented Google Sign-In via Firebase with additional user data in MySQL. Streamlined signup process and improved scalability.

info.title: 🎉 Results
info.content: Robust authentication system reduced friction and increased reliability. Better user experience with secure, scalable foundation.

info.title: 🚀 Future Improvements
info.content: Add direct messaging for real-time communication. Integrate AI chatbot for 24/7 support and booking guidance. Personalized recommendations based on user data.
